contentList.content: This hand crossbow is exceptionally good at finding your target's weak points.
Your enemies will never see you coming.
You look at the bolts of this crossbow: They burn orange with fire. No, they gleam with icy frost. No, wait, they sizzle with electricity. Wait, actually-- You stop looking at the crossbow bolts.
Little sibling of Bolt of All Trades.
You don't even need firearm proficiency!
It's shocking how handy this crossbow is.
The Right Tool for the Job
There is just something... irresistible about this crossbow.
"I dispense wisdom." "What is your wisdom?" "Scratch is the goodest boy." "That's a good wisdom."
Won't let your enemies get any bright ideas.
A prototype crossbow invented by Cleff Tinkertop of the city of Hupperdook.
A force to be reckoned with.
A series of names got engraved with loving care on this crossbow: dezitk, dimzki, dmarquez, Grimpreacher, HEIIFIREJINX, ZazyMomba
An ethereal hand crossbow, it vibrates between realities, echoing the essence of phase spiders.
This hand crossbow is engraved with arcane symbols and emits a faint magical aura.
This hand crossbow features a carved grip resembling a scorpion's tail and has a subtle green glow.
This crossbow features two parallel firing chambers and bolts for dual shots.
This eerie hand crossbow is constructed from darkwood and adorned with shadowy engravings.

Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it may also inflict: <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ACID">Acid</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poisoned</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHILLED">Chilled</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burning</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SHOCKED">Shocked</LSTag>, or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED">Off Balance</LSTag> unless the target succeeds a Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>.
This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag>.
This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Wisdom <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag>.
This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Intelligence <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag>.
When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> with this weapon, you gain an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag>.
The crossbow misfires on a Critical Miss, dealing 1d6 Piercing damage to the wielder.
On a successful Hit, the blow may push the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED">Off Balance</LSTag>.

Give your weapon a +1 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and an additional 1d4 Acid, Poison, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage to its strikes depending on the type of bolt chosen.
The crossbow can be unequipped and equipped again, but has to stay on the spellcaster's person.
Gain a +1 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and deal an additional [1]

Once per battle, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to make a ranged attack against up to 3 separate targets within range. Each target takes 1d6 Force damage.

Once per battle, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to fire a venomous bolt that deals 1d6 Piercing and 1d6 Poison damage on a hit and an additional 1d4 Poison damage at the start of the target's next 2 turns.
If the attack misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage in the following turns.
Takes [1] at the start of its turn.

Once per battle, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to fire two bolts simultaneously at the same target. On a miss, you receive 1d4 penalty to <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> for 1 turn.

Once per battle, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to make a ranged attack that deals an additional 1d6 necrotic damage and heals you for 1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.
